title: Immunohistochemistry analysis
protocol: Perform immunohistochemistry for chemokine receptors CXCR1, CXCR3, and CXCR4 on first trimester human placental paraffin-embedded sections.
Use microwave antigen retrieval with sodium citrate buffer.
Stain with isotype match controls for each chemokine receptor.
Prepare NCR-Fc fusion proteins as previously described.
Perform immunohistochemistry on decidual sections using the prepared NCR-Fc fusion proteins or control-Fc (8 μg/ml, final concentration).
Detect using the avidin-biotin peroxidase complex method with a Vectastain kit.
